question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word.

Reluctant
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "Unwilling or hesitant."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Reluctant"** means unwilling or hesitant to do something. (अनिच्छुक या झिझकने वाला)

 
 
• **Example:** She was reluctant to share her personal details with strangers.
 
 
 
• **"Unwilling or hesitant" **describes the state of being unsure or not inclined to act voluntarily. (अनिच्छुक)
 
 
• **Example:** He was unwilling to participate in the event due to lack of preparation.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "Reluctant" aligns with the meaning "Unwilling or hesitant."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Carefree and indifferent **(बेपरवाह और उदासीन): Someone who does not show concern or worry about things.

 
 
• **Example:** He seemed carefree and indifferent about the consequences of his actions.
 
 
 
• **Confused and unsure **(उलझन में और अनिश्चित): A state of being perplexed or not certain about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt confused and unsure about which course to choose.
 
 
 
• **Eager and enthusiastic **(उत्सुक और उत्साही): Showing interest, excitement, or readiness to do something.
 
 
• **Example:** The students were eager and enthusiastic to participate in the science fair.
 
 

37:Tbf3,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
